record_title: Exact dependence of jackknife pseudo-values for U-statistics
provenance: Exact Hoeffding-order decomposition of delete-one pseudo-value covariance for complete one-sample U-statistics, with a sharp correlation envelope and a jackknife-bias identity.
limitations: Complete one-sample U-statistics with square-integrable symmetric kernels and delete-one jackknifing only. The result does not contradict asymptotic pseudo-value independence. The complete theorem text of Arvesen (1969) and Shi (1984) was not inspected and remains a residual originality risk.
